mechanism: Semaglutide delays gastric emptying and reduces GI motility, which may impair the absorption of atovaquone, a poorly absorbed antiprotozoal agent that requires adequate GI transit time and acidic conditions for optimal bioavailability.
action: Monitor atovaquone efficacy closely; consider alternative antimicrobial agents if possible, or separate dosing by several hours and ensure adequate fat intake with atovaquone administration.
